statements.text: Assessment: left lumbar radiculopathy at L4-L5 due to disc herniation with foraminal stenosis.
MRI lumbar spine 09/07/2026: L4-L5 disc herniation with moderate left foraminal stenosis contacting the exiting nerve root.
Pain limits walking to about one block and has forced the patient to stop volunteering; sleep is disrupted most nights.
Baseline ODI prior to any intervention: 49%.
Symptoms began on 07/12/2026, 11 weeks before this visit.
PT discharge summary: completed 5 weeks of physical therapy (07/23/2026 to 08/27/2026) without meaningful improvement; naproxen 500 mg BID for the same period without relief.
Continues the daily home exercise program taught in PT.
